snippet.title: Trials Fusion Riders of the Rustlands DLC Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore the wastelands across all new tracks and challenges in the first of six expansions for Trials Fusion. The expansion also includes all new achievements (and squirrels!) and editor objects. Riders of the Rustlands is available now on Xbox One, Playstation 4, Xbox 360, and PC.
